meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 BGPT 的 search_papers 工具搜索科学论文,每篇返回 25+ 个结构化字段:方法、结果、样本量、质量评分、结论。
howto.when: 当你需要带具体实验细节的论文、做系统综述或证据汇总,或找摘要里没有的实验数据时使用;需先在 MCP 设置中配置 BGPT 服务器。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude calls BGPT's search_papers tool to find scientific papers and returns 25+ structured fields per paper: methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores and conclusions.
howto.when_en: Use when you need papers with specific experimental details, systematic or scoping reviews, evidence synthesis, or data not in abstracts. Requires the BGPT MCP server configured in the host.

say_en.note: Returns paper results with structured fields

say_en.text: Compile sample sizes and effect sizes from these studies into an evidence table
say_en.note: Extracts quantitative data for evidence synthesis
